answer: American Express's net cash provided by operating activities increased by 43.9% from fiscal year 2021 to fiscal year 2022. Net cash provided by operating activities was $14,645 million ($14.6 billion) in fiscal year 2021 and $21,079 million ($21.1 billion) in fiscal year 2022.
rationale: Using the exact reported figures from the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows ($14,645 million in 2021 and $21,079 million in 2022), the percentage change is calculated as ((21,079 - 14,645) / 14,645) * 100 = 43.933%, which rounds to 43.9%. Using the table in billions ($14.6 billion to $21.1 billion) yields 44.5%, but the more precise numbers from the financial statements give 43.9%. Both are supported.
